model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing the framework for the use of the European Union Critical Communication System by the Member States’ services and other organisations in charge of civil protection and amending Regulation (EU) …/…

summary.text: This proposal aims to establish rules for how member states and civil protection organisations would use a European critical communications system. It seeks to enable these organisations to coordinate and communicate effectively during emergencies and crises.
